build_Pose3dHeatmapHead: build a Pose3dHeatmapHead model to predict 3D pose from multi-scale feature maps using depth and camera intrinsics
create_compute_pose3d: create a function that computes 3D keypoints from 2D pose, depth values, and per-keypoint camera intrinsics
create_compute_pose2d: create a function that projects 3D keypoints to 2D using per-keypoint camera intrinsics K matrix
decode_heatmap_softargmax: decode 2D pose heatmaps to keypoints using softargmax with configurable temperature beta parameter
compute_losses_pose3d: compute multi-component losses for 3D pose including L1, camera intrinsics, relative depth, and 2D pose
